svg.title: The log is flushed first. That is why "none" survives a power cut.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The log is flushed first. That is why "none" survives a power cut.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A transaction box with BEGIN at the top and COMMIT at the bottom containing a debit of 50 000 and a matching credit, struck by a red lightning bolt labelled kill -9. The balances before and after the crash are identical at 100 000 each. Below, a numbered pair of steps shows the write-ahead log record being fsynced first and the data pages written later, with the reversed order crossed out in red.
svg.text: The log is flushed first. That is why "none" survives a power cut.
